description: Ministry of Lands - Land Acquisition - 193/1-8, Compensation for the Lands acquiring Akurana D/S Division, Kandy District - DLA 27/16, DLD 109/16, DLD 93/16, DLA 91/16, DLA 33/16, DLA 89/16, DLA 86/16
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple notices under Section 33 of the Land Acquisition Act regarding compensation payments for specific land acquisitions. The content includes detailed land descriptions, plot numbers, extents, and boundary information for various land parcels in the Akurana Division. This falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" including "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined for Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
